What is This Part?
These are the CONE WASHERS & BOLTS that fit onto the Locking Hubs.
INCLUDES Two Full Sets of Cone Washers & Bolts (Does BOTH Locking Hubs)
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 12 – Cone Washers
Qty 12 – Bolts

What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
